cd /app && cat > /tmp/check.py <<'EOF'
import math, random, subprocess
M=1<<32
def fib(n):
    a,b=0,1
    for _ in range(n): a,b=b,(a+b)%M
    return a
cases=list(range(0,300))
for k in list(range(1,200))+[1000,1001,30000,46340,65535,65534,65535]:
    for d in (-1,0,1):
        v=k*k+d
        if 0<=v<M: cases.append(v)
cases+= [random.randrange(M) for _ in range(120)]+[M-1,M-2,0,1]
cases=sorted(set(cases))
bad=0
outs=subprocess.run(["bash","-c","cd /app; for n in "+" ".join(map(str,cases))+"; do ./sim $n; done"],capture_output=True,text=True).stdout.split()
assert len(outs)==len(cases),(len(outs),len(cases))
for n,o in zip(cases,outs):
    exp=fib(math.isqrt(n))
    if int(o)!=exp:
        bad+=1; print("FAIL",n,o,exp)
print("cases",len(cases),"bad",bad)
EOF
time python3 /tmp/check.py
